# OanK Cleaning AI Documentation

OanK Cleaning is a professional cleaning service provider based in Paisley, serving the Glasgow area and wider Scotland. We offer comprehensive cleaning solutions for domestic, commercial, and specialist healthcare settings.

## Service Areas
- Paisley
- Glasgow
- Scotland

## Cleaning Services
- **Domestic Cleaning**: Regular home maintenance and housekeeping.
- **Deep & Spring Cleaning**: Thorough, one-off deep cleaning services.
- **End of Tenancy**: Move-out cleaning services ensuring 100% deposit return.
- **Commercial & Office Cleaning**: Tailored solutions for businesses and offices.
- **Healthcare & Care Home Cleaning**: Specialist cleaning protocols for healthcare environments.
- **Carpet & Upholstery Care**: Deep cleaning for carpets and furniture.

## API Resources
- [Quote Request API](/api/quote): Accepts JSON payloads for instant quote estimates.
- [Contact API](/api/contact): For general service enquiries.
